delivery_boundary.declaration_entry_point: HTTP catalog/deletion_http.py::deletion_requests，內部呼叫服務層 catalog/deletion.py declare()；來源授權 source_for() 要求租戶分區與資料集 owner 皆相符，否則 404
delivery_boundary.dry_run: POST .../deletion-requests/dry-run 只列 lineage 影響（DeletionImpact），不寫任何列，可重複呼叫
delivery_boundary.async_convergence: catalog/deletion.py::due()／propagate()，經 catalog/tasks.py::relay_deletion 與 catalog.deletion_tick 派至 foundation queue；逐項核對 tombstone 才轉 DONE，全部完成才轉 COMPLETED 並遞增 revision
delivery_boundary.policy_gate: AXIOM_DELETION_PROPAGATION_ENABLED 預設 0；D-05 未決前宣告停在 BLOCKED 並帶 FEATURE_DISABLED，due() 名單為空、propagate() 回 503
delivery_boundary.feature_flag_added: backend/config/settings.py 的 DELETION_PROPAGATION_ENABLED，compose.yaml 以 ${AXIOM_DELETION_PROPAGATION_ENABLED:-0} 明示預設關閉
delivery_boundary.contract_sync: openapi-v2.json 新增 2 path／3 operation 與 DeletionImpact／DeletionRequestView schema；AX-21 端點表同步；api_operations 30→33

tests.unittest_command: docker compose -p axiom-dev run --rm -T web python manage.py test

all_backend_images_rebuilt.reason: ingest／profile／search／worker／relay 仍執行舊 image 時，environment() 的 code_digest 與重建後的 web 不一致，INGEST 以 CHECKPOINT_INCOMPATIBLE 失敗
all_backend_images_rebuilt.action: docker compose up -d --build web worker relay ingest profile search，使所有 backend 服務共用同一份程式指紋
all_backend_images_rebuilt.scope: 僅本機可丟棄開發堆疊
